title: Prove and cost one physical inverse-coded FULL/thin pair
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

```text
pre Y: C^-1 -> backward FULL -> thin Q^-1 C^-1 -> post Y: Q^-1 C Q
                         = [[D,-DQ],[DQ^-1,0]]
```

Proves every block of one physical stage37/38 pair on arbitrary independent main inputs and the typed all-positive-width lift, retaining all 408 autonomous helpers. The complete emitted field ledger charges 336 extra rank-one jobs, including 224 for the actual exit conjugation; it does not import the scalar p19 invoice. This resolves the changed-operator handoff from #5036, separate from two-stage terminal-code products.

## Validation

- **Before:** scalar A^-1 leaves the signed physical residual D(I-A^-1 C); the old owner1/address1 witness still fails. **After:** actual source signs pass 57,344 absolute-phase checks, 1,792 basis-column comparisons across width1/2 fibers, eight mixed inputs and every Walsh coefficient of that physical fixture. Six semantic controls reject missing/misordered recoding, signs and helper cleanup.
- Registered normal and optimized checks, committed-byte/source-history checks and a Git-free exported direct replay pass at `65445e68d79d7e9f289d4f97e0aa4a8416f2438f`. Direct replay takes about one second. The written operator proof supplies all-width coverage; finite width2 fibers are corroboration, not exhaustive physical-address enumeration.
- Credit Cayden Burkart/SethBurkart123 #4940, Dillon #4933, Dugongue #4929, Cinna Davis #4440/#4470/#4694/#4698, Cao Yifan, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman, and retained native/Clifford/precision contributors. Prepared for JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way.

**Blast Radius:** Isolated.

Only a new research package. Physical field-map/precision tariffs and complete caller affordability remain open; the family decision is to stop here until that complete budget is supplied. No full native/p19 replay, selected-frontier update, new kappa or full multiplication theorem is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Refined task `b2_math_physical_inverse_pair` on card `centre-path-sharing`; [canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4930#discussioncomment-19140791). Scientific base `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`, priority revision7; refreshed canonical main is unchanged at the submission checkpoint. Exact dependency heads and retained source/path/hash records are in the scoped package. The claim states predecessor coverage, changed premise, live parallel exclusions and bounded stop rule. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are outside overlap coverage.

## Open next questions

See [the package questions](research/physical-inverse-pair/README.md#open-next-questions) for the smallest remaining caller/interface obligation and its blocker. This contribution stops at the stated scoped result.

Reproduce with CPython3.12 on macOS arm64: `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/physical-inverse-pair`. A separate Astra review of this exact HEAD found no actionable issue and reran normal/optimized targeted checks. Scientific review remains AI-assisted, not human or proof-kernel acceptance.
